_comment: SHARED GOLDEN — two BYTE-IDENTICAL copies exist until a shared cross-repo fixture mechanism lands: choreograph/src/test/fixtures/ingest_request.golden.json and garden/src-tauri/src/emporium/fixtures/ingest_request.golden.json. Any edit to one MUST be mirrored verbatim to the other. `request` is the EXACT serialized IngestRequest that choreograph's buildIngestRequest(sampleRun, sampleSha) produces; it is the wire contract between Choreograph (TS producer) and Garden/emporium (Rust consumer, schemas.rs). The TS golden test deep-equals `request` against buildIngestRequest; the Rust golden test deserializes `request` into IngestRequest via serde. A field rename/drop on either side fails its test.
